system.description: You howl, and a creature within 30' feels the old hunger in the blood.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but the frenzy lasts until the end of its second turn.
outcomes.success: Until the end of its next turn, the creature is Quickened, deals an additional d6 damage on each hit, and must attack the nearest creature, friend or foe. A frenzied foe cannot be demoralised.
outcomes.ruin: The hunger takes you: on your next turn, you must attack the nearest creature. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
